name: Rou
source:
Rou is a ghoul who appears in the video game Tokyo Ghoul: Jail. She is one of the suspects in the search for Jail, and a member of the Ghoul Restaurant in the 7th ward. 

[From [url=http://tokyoghoul.wikia.com/wiki/Rou]Tokyo Ghoul Wikia[/url]]
